details:
Sometimes you'll find "H3 text" as a title with "Performance: 👑 Original" (no picture). Sometimes content warnings are recognized to be on the avatar, but not listed (until client restart). Sometimes the info of the previous avatar is displayed.

Steps to reproduce: Attached a video. View "Current Avatar" from Quick Menu winglet to view the old avatar details page.

Expected result: Refresh the avatar details after the avatar has finished loading. Refresh the avatar details to show the current avatar's details if you change avatars.

Actual result: Incorrect data from the previous avatar may be displayed if the avatar details were viewed while the avatar was loading, or none at all.
